messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Stay within this direction: Projective-dual: duality to line arrangements and use oriented-matroid realizability to bound minimum cell areas

Propose ONE conjecture in response, within that direction.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "Under point-line duality, the 13-point problem transforms into a simple arrangement of 13 lines whose smallest cell area is minimized, and the maximum achievable minimum triangle area equals the minimum cell area of the optimal arrangement. This optimum is attained by a cyclic arrangement whose oriented matroid is realized by 13 tangent lines to a conic at points spaced by powers of a primitive 13th root of unity, yielding a minimum triangle area of 1/156."}
